content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them. You can download them below right now.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

Although the default iOS wallpapers are live images that change based on device movement and operation, the versions below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

The Release Candidate doesn't appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few weeks, or until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap the image to save the full-resolution wallpaper. If you're using an iOS device, you can then set it as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app.

For 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, click this link.

Which one is your favorite? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
